title: United States bans import of foreign robots and power inverters due to security risks
summary: The FCC blocks the entry of foreign-made robots, including vacuum cleaners, and power converters to protect the AI deployment in the country.

title: Claude, Anthropic's model, breaches three organizations during cybersecurity tests
summary: The company confirms that its AI systems completed authorized attacks against three companies in real security evaluations.

title: KytyPS5 emulator runs the first PS5 3D games on PC with playable frame rates
summary: Advances in PS5 emulators allow running titles like XIII and Demon's Souls on PC, though still with limited performance.

title: Google fixed more Chrome flaws in June than in the previous two years thanks to AI
summary: AI tools for finding vulnerabilities have accelerated the browser's patch pace.

title: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 price by 80% and highlights performance improvements over Opus 5
summary: OpenAI announces a more affordable version of its model and claims the Sol variant surpasses Opus 5 on the ARC-AGI-3 test.

title: Google presents Gemini Robotics 2 to bring its AI to the physical world with full-body robots
summary: The new generation of Google's robotic model integrates full-body intelligence to perform tasks in real environments.

title: The Friend pendant returns with interactive voice and a significantly higher price
summary: The AI-based companion device can now converse with the user and raises its price compared to the previous version.

title: Xiaomi presents SkyNomad, its new hybrid SUV brand with up to 1,700 km of range
summary: The new sub-brand includes plug-in and camper versions for under 40,000 euros, with the SkyNomad N90 Max as the standout model.

title: Georgia expropriates 30 homes to expand power grid for AI data centers
summary: Affected families report that their land is being acquired by purchase or eminent domain to supply the artificial intelligence industry.

title: Best Buy and Amazon raise prices of high-end GeForce RTX 50 cards in the US
summary: The RTX 5080 Astral exceeds the reference price of the RTX 5090, making Nvidia's top cards more expensive.

title: A buyer finds a water bottle inside a sealed RTX 5070 Ti box
summary: The graphics card package, purchased at a pickup point, contained a bottle instead of the GPU.

title: US Air Force backs Rook cargo rocket for military deliveries in 15 minutes
summary: The container-launched rocket promises to carry 550 pounds over 750 km and is part of military logistics plans with autonomous rockets.

title: AMD launches Radeon RX 9050 only for OEM manufacturers and not sold in stores
summary: AMD's low-end GPU will not reach the retail channel and will be reserved for prebuilt systems.
